requirements.title: Configuration file present
requirements.text: The tool shall verify that a .fusa.json configuration file exists in the project root.

requirements.title: Rust manifest present
requirements.text: The tool shall verify that a Cargo.toml manifest exists, confirming the project is a Rust crate.

requirements.title: License declared
requirements.text: The tool shall verify that a LICENSE file is present for IP clarity in safety submissions.

requirements.title: Project documentation present
requirements.text: The tool shall verify that a README file is present for assessors and integrators.

requirements.title: Continuous integration configured
requirements.text: The tool shall verify that a CI configuration is present for automated verification.

requirements.title: Config schema version
requirements.text: The .fusa.json configuration file shall include a configVersion field equal to '1.0'.

requirements.title: Project name required
requirements.text: The .fusa.json configuration file shall include a non-empty project.name field.

requirements.title: Safety standard declared
requirements.text: The .fusa.json configuration file shall declare a standard field (e.g. iso26262, iec61508, do178c).

requirements.title: Integrity level declared
requirements.text: The .fusa.json configuration file shall declare one of asil, sil, or dal to specify the target integrity level.

requirements.title: Config version validated
requirements.text: The tool shall reject configuration files with an unsupported configVersion and exit with code 3.

requirements.title: ASIL values validated
requirements.text: The tool shall validate that the asil field, if present, contains one of QM, ASIL-A, ASIL-B, ASIL-C, ASIL-D.

requirements.title: SIL values validated
requirements.text: The tool shall validate that the sil field, if present, contains one of SIL-1, SIL-2, SIL-3, SIL-4.

requirements.title: DAL values validated
requirements.text: The tool shall validate that the dal field, if present, contains one of DAL-A, DAL-B, DAL-C, DAL-D.

requirements.title: Exit code semantics
requirements.text: The tool shall exit 0 on success, 1 on gate failure, 2 on usage error, 3 on runtime error.

requirements.title: JSON output conformance
requirements.text: The tool shall emit x-FuSa spec v1.9 conformant JSON from all reporting commands.

requirements.title: Fingerprint computation
requirements.text: The tool shall compute SHA-256 fingerprints per x-FuSa spec §4.2 for every finding.

requirements.title: Common header on all JSON documents
requirements.text: All JSON documents produced by the tool shall include schemaVersion, kind, tool, toolVersion, language, generatedAt fields (x-FuSa spec §3.1).

requirements.title: Format flag support
requirements.text: All reporting commands shall support --format text|json as a minimum; check and report additionally support html, sarif, and md.

requirements.title: Output file flag
requirements.text: All reporting commands shall support --output <file> to write results to a file.

requirements.title: Directory flag
requirements.text: All file-scanning commands shall support --dir <path> to target a specific project root.

requirements.title: Strict mode gate
requirements.text: Commands that support --strict shall exit 1 on WARNING findings in addition to ERROR findings.

requirements.title: Version command
requirements.text: The version command shall print tool name, version, and spec version; with --format json shall emit a valid x-FuSa JSON document.

requirements.title: Capabilities command
requirements.text: The capabilities command shall enumerate all supported commands, formats, rules, and standards in machine-readable JSON.

requirements.title: Help text present
requirements.text: The tool shall print usage text when invoked without arguments or with help/--help/-h.

requirements.title: Unknown command error
requirements.text: The tool shall exit with code 2 and print an error message when given an unknown subcommand.

requirements.title: Rule registry
requirements.text: The engine shall maintain a registry of all active rules loadable at startup.

requirements.title: File scanning
requirements.text: The engine shall recursively scan all .rs source files under the project src/ directory.

requirements.title: Finding deduplication
requirements.text: The engine shall deduplicate findings by fingerprint within a single scan run.

requirements.title: Severity classification
requirements.text: Every finding shall carry one of ERROR, WARNING, or INFO severity.

requirements.title: Category classification
requirements.text: Every finding shall carry one of lint, style, safety, security, coverage, requirement, concurrency, supply-chain, config, or other category.

requirements.title: Disposition suppression
requirements.text: Findings with an accepted or deferred disposition in .fusa-dispositions.json shall not count toward gate failure.

requirements.title: Scan excludes tests
requirements.text: The engine shall exclude files matched by the excludePaths configuration key from scanning.

requirements.title: Error on missing config
requirements.text: The tool shall print an actionable error message when .fusa.json is missing or malformed.

requirements.title: Error on file I/O failure
requirements.text: The tool shall print the failing path and OS error when a file read or write fails, then exit 3.

requirements.title: Error on parse failure
requirements.text: The tool shall print the failing file path and parse error when JSON or TOML parsing fails, then exit 3.

requirements.title: Unsafe code justified
requirements.text: The tool shall flag unsafe blocks that lack a //fusa:unsafe justification on the preceding line.

requirements.title: No unexplained panics
requirements.text: The tool shall flag .unwrap() calls in non-test code as they can cause unhandled process termination.

requirements.title: No unexplained expect
requirements.text: The tool shall flag .expect() calls in non-test code as they can cause unhandled process termination.

requirements.title: No todo macro
requirements.text: The tool shall flag todo!() and unimplemented!() macros that indicate incomplete safety-critical code.

requirements.title: No transmute
requirements.text: The tool shall flag std::mem::transmute usage as type-safety violation.

requirements.title: No mem forget
requirements.text: The tool shall flag std::mem::forget usage as a potential resource leak.

requirements.title: Function length limit
requirements.text: The tool shall flag functions exceeding 60 lines as WARNING (ANA001).

requirements.title: Nesting depth limit
requirements.text: The tool shall flag code blocks with indentation exceeding 5 levels as WARNING (ANA002).

requirements.title: Parameter count limit
requirements.text: The tool shall flag functions with more than 7 parameters as WARNING (ANA003).

requirements.title: Raw pointer dereference
requirements.text: The tool shall flag raw pointer dereferences lacking //fusa:unsafe justification as WARNING (ANA004).

requirements.title: Integer truncating cast
requirements.text: The tool shall flag integer narrowing casts (as u8/i8/u16/i16) as WARNING (ANA005) per ISO 26262 6.4.6.

requirements.title: Multiple return points
requirements.text: The tool shall flag functions with more than 3 explicit return statements as INFO (ANA006).

requirements.title: Hardcoded credentials
requirements.text: The tool shall flag hardcoded passwords, secrets, and API keys (CWE-798) as ERROR.

requirements.title: SQL injection
requirements.text: The tool shall flag SQL string concatenation patterns (CWE-89) as ERROR.

requirements.title: Path traversal
requirements.text: The tool shall flag path construction from user input (CWE-22) as ERROR.

requirements.title: Weak random
requirements.text: The tool shall flag use of non-cryptographic random generators (CWE-330) as WARNING.

requirements.title: Unchecked arithmetic
requirements.text: The tool shall flag integer overflow/underflow patterns (CWE-190) as WARNING.

requirements.title: Cleartext HTTP
requirements.text: The tool shall flag non-TLS HTTP endpoints (CWE-319) as ERROR.

requirements.title: Command injection
requirements.text: The tool shall flag shell command construction from variables (CWE-78) as ERROR.

requirements.title: Deprecated crypto
requirements.text: The tool shall flag use of deprecated cryptographic algorithms (CWE-327) as ERROR.

requirements.title: Sensitive logging
requirements.text: The tool shall flag logging of potential secrets and passwords (CWE-532) as WARNING.

requirements.title: Unvalidated deserialize
requirements.text: The tool shall flag deserialize calls without preceding validation (CWE-502) as WARNING.

requirements.title: Unchecked slice index
requirements.text: The tool shall flag direct slice indexing without bounds check (CWE-125) as WARNING.

requirements.title: Unbounded allocation
requirements.text: The tool shall flag potential unbounded vector allocation (CWE-400) as WARNING.

requirements.title: TLS bypass
requirements.text: The tool shall flag TLS certificate verification disable patterns (CWE-295) as ERROR.

requirements.title: TOCTOU check
requirements.text: The tool shall flag time-of-check/time-of-use patterns (CWE-367) as WARNING.

requirements.title: Insecure file permissions
requirements.text: The tool shall flag broad file permission settings (CWE-732) as WARNING.

requirements.title: Environment secret exposure
requirements.text: The tool shall flag environment variable secret exposure (CWE-526) as WARNING.

requirements.title: Path from user input
requirements.text: The tool shall flag path construction from user-controlled input (CWE-22) as ERROR.

requirements.title: ManuallyDrop usage
requirements.text: The tool shall flag ManuallyDrop usage as potential use-after-free (CWE-415) as WARNING.

requirements.title: Format string from external
requirements.text: The tool shall flag format string construction from external data (CWE-134) as WARNING.

requirements.title: Unchecked from_utf8
requirements.text: The tool shall flag unchecked UTF-8 conversion (CWE-20) as WARNING.

requirements.title: Requirement annotation scan
requirements.text: The trace command shall scan source files for //fusa:req annotations and build a requirement-to-file mapping.

requirements.title: Test annotation scan
requirements.text: The trace command shall scan source files for //fusa:test annotations and record which requirements have test coverage.

requirements.title: Sec-test annotation scan
requirements.text: The trace command shall scan source files for //fusa:sec-test annotations and record security test coverage.

requirements.title: Trace matrix output
requirements.text: The trace command shall output a matrix with tracedRequirements, testedRequirements, and secTestedRequirements (x-FuSa spec §5).

requirements.title: Untested requirement detection
requirements.text: The trace command with --strict shall exit 1 if any requirement in .fusa-reqs.json lacks a //fusa:test annotation.

requirements.title: Untraced requirement detection
requirements.text: The trace command shall report requirements that have no //fusa:req implementation annotation.

requirements.title: Trace JSON schema
requirements.text: The trace command shall produce a trace.json conforming to x-FuSa spec §5 schema.

requirements.title: JSON report schema
requirements.text: Check reports shall include findings[], summary.errors, summary.warnings, and summary.infos fields.

requirements.title: SARIF output
requirements.text: The check command shall produce SARIF 2.1.0 output with runs[0].tool.driver and results[] when --format sarif is specified.

requirements.title: HTML report
requirements.text: The report command shall produce a self-contained HTML report when --format html is specified.

requirements.title: Markdown report
requirements.text: The report command shall produce a Markdown report when --format md is specified.

requirements.title: Report always exits 0
requirements.text: The report command shall always exit 0 regardless of finding severity, unlike check which exits 1 on ERROR.

requirements.title: Tool qualification test suite
requirements.text: The qualify command shall run a defined set of qualification test cases and report pass/fail for each.

requirements.title: Qualification report
requirements.text: The qualify command shall write qualify-report.json with x-FuSa §3.1 header and per-case results.

requirements.title: Qualification gate
requirements.text: The qualify command shall exit 1 if any qualification case fails.

requirements.title: Qualification hash
requirements.text: The qualify command shall compute a deterministic hash over its results using RFC 8785 canonical JSON (x-FuSa spec §6).

requirements.title: SBOM generation
requirements.text: The release command shall produce sbom.json listing all Cargo dependencies with their hashes.

requirements.title: SBOM hash format
requirements.text: Dependency hashes in sbom.json shall be formatted as algo:value (e.g. sha256:abc123) per x-FuSa spec §7.

requirements.title: Provenance generation
requirements.text: The release command shall produce provenance.json with build metadata including git commit, branch, and timestamp.

requirements.title: Artifact manifest generation
requirements.text: The release command shall produce artifact-manifest.json listing all evidence files with SHA-256 checksums.

requirements.title: Cargo.lock integrity
requirements.text: The release command shall verify that Cargo.lock is present and record its hash in the artifact manifest.

requirements.title: SBOM module field
requirements.text: The SBOM shall include a module field with the package name and version from Cargo.toml.

requirements.title: SBOM component registry source
requirements.text: SBOM components shall include the registry source URL where available.

requirements.title: Provenance reproducibility
requirements.text: The provenance document shall record the Rust toolchain version used at build time.

requirements.title: Audit pack ZIP
requirements.text: The audit-pack command shall produce a single ZIP file with all evidence files at the archive root.

requirements.title: Audit pack manifest
requirements.text: The audit pack shall include a manifest.json with bare-hex SHA-256 per entry (x-FuSa spec §8).

requirements.title: Audit pack listing
requirements.text: The audit-pack command shall accept --list to enumerate archive contents without extraction.

requirements.title: Audit pack exit code
requirements.text: The audit-pack command shall exit 1 if no evidence files are found to bundle.

requirements.title: Test execution via cargo
requirements.text: The verify command shall invoke cargo test and capture pass/fail counts.

requirements.title: Test evidence document
requirements.text: The verify command shall write .fusa-evidence.json with x-FuSa §3.1 header and test run summary.

requirements.title: Verify gate on failure
requirements.text: The verify command shall exit 1 if any test fails.

requirements.title: Test evidence timestamp
requirements.text: The .fusa-evidence.json document shall record the timestamp at which verification was performed.

requirements.title: Test evidence counts
requirements.text: The .fusa-evidence.json document shall record passed, failed, and ignored test counts.

requirements.title: FMEA from source
requirements.text: The fmea command shall derive FMEA entries from public functions declared in Rust source files.

requirements.title: Failure mode mapping
requirements.text: The fmea command shall map function return types to potential failure modes and effects.

requirements.title: ASIL severity mapping
requirements.text: The fmea command shall map configured ASIL level to failure severity ratings.

requirements.title: Risk classification
requirements.text: The fmea command shall classify each failure as HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW risk based on severity and detection rating.

requirements.title: FMEA JSON output
requirements.text: The fmea command shall write fmea.json with x-FuSa §3.1 header and an entries[] array.

requirements.title: FMEA CSV output
requirements.text: The fmea command shall write fmea.csv suitable for import into safety management tools.

requirements.title: Boundary diagram generation
requirements.text: The boundary command shall generate a dependency boundary diagram from Cargo.toml and source imports.

requirements.title: Graphviz DOT output
requirements.text: The boundary command shall write boundary.dot in Graphviz DOT format.

requirements.title: Mermaid diagram output
requirements.text: The boundary command shall write boundary.mermaid in Mermaid graph LR format.

requirements.title: External dependency nodes
requirements.text: The boundary diagram shall include all Cargo.toml dependencies as external nodes.

requirements.title: Internal module nodes
requirements.text: The boundary diagram shall include internal src/ modules as nodes connected by use crate:: imports.

requirements.title: Vulnerability scan
requirements.text: The vuln command shall scan Cargo.lock for known CVEs using cargo-audit or equivalent.

requirements.title: Vulnerability JSON output
requirements.text: The vuln command shall write vuln.json with x-FuSa §3.1 header and vulnerabilities[] array.

requirements.title: Vulnerability gate
requirements.text: The vuln command shall exit 1 if any vulnerabilities are found.

requirements.title: CVE identifiers
requirements.text: Each vulnerability entry shall include the CVE identifier where available.

requirements.title: Severity level
requirements.text: Each vulnerability entry shall include a severity level (critical, high, medium, low).

requirements.title: Cargo-audit fallback
requirements.text: When cargo-audit is not installed, the vuln command shall scan Cargo.lock directly and advise installation.

requirements.title: STRIDE threat mapping
requirements.text: The tara command shall map cyber findings to STRIDE threat categories per ISO 21434.

requirements.title: CWE mapping
requirements.text: Each TARA entry shall include the CWE identifier corresponding to the threat.

requirements.title: Risk rating
requirements.text: Each TARA entry shall include a risk rating (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW).

requirements.title: TARA JSON output
requirements.text: The tara command shall write tara.json with x-FuSa §3.1 header and threats[] array.

requirements.title: TARA Markdown output
requirements.text: The tara command shall write tara.md with a human-readable threat register table.

requirements.title: Safety case GSN
requirements.text: The safety-case command shall generate a Goal Structuring Notation (GSN) safety argument.

requirements.title: Safety case evidence check
requirements.text: The safety-case command shall check for the presence of all required evidence files.

requirements.title: Safety case JSON
requirements.text: The safety-case command shall write safety-case.json with evidence status.

requirements.title: Safety case Markdown
requirements.text: The safety-case command shall write safety-case.md with a human-readable evidence summary.

requirements.title: Safety case Mermaid
requirements.text: The safety-case command shall write safety-case.mermaid with a graph TB GSN diagram.

requirements.title: Single binary
requirements.text: The tool shall be distributed as a single statically-linked binary requiring no runtime dependencies.

requirements.title: Spec conformance
requirements.text: The tool shall conform to x-FuSa spec version 1.9.

requirements.title: Deterministic output
requirements.text: Given identical inputs, the tool shall produce byte-identical JSON output (excluding generatedAt timestamps).

requirements.title: HARA file management
requirements.text: The hara command shall read and write .fusa-hara.json with hazard definitions including severity, exposure, controllability, and ASIL.

requirements.title: ASIL derivation
requirements.text: The hara asil subcommand shall derive ASIL level from severity, exposure, and controllability per ISO 26262 Part 3 Table 4.

requirements.title: HARA init template
requirements.text: The hara init subcommand shall create a .fusa-hara.json template with one example hazard if the file does not exist.

requirements.title: HARA tabular display
requirements.text: The hara show subcommand shall display hazards in a tabular format showing ID, description, S, E, C, and ASIL columns.

requirements.title: HARA JSON header
requirements.text: The .fusa-hara.json file shall include the x-FuSa §3.1 common header.

requirements.title: HTML report self-contained
requirements.text: HTML reports shall be self-contained (no external asset dependencies) for offline use in safety submissions.

requirements.title: HTML findings table
requirements.text: HTML reports shall include a findings table with rule ID, severity, file, line, and message columns.

requirements.title: HTML summary section
requirements.text: HTML reports shall include a summary section showing error, warning, and info counts.

requirements.title: End-to-end qualification
requirements.text: The tool qualification suite shall exercise all §9.1 MUST commands and verify correct exit codes and output schemas.

requirements.title: Safety case completeness gate
requirements.text: The safety-case command shall exit 1 when fewer than 50% of required evidence files are present.

requirements.title: Requirements file schema
requirements.text: The .fusa-reqs.json file shall conform to the x-FuSa requirements schema with id, title, text, standard, and level fields.

requirements.title: Requirements unique IDs
requirements.text: All requirement IDs in .fusa-reqs.json shall be unique within the file.

requirements.title: Requirements import/export
requirements.text: The req command shall support import and export of requirements in JSON and CSV formats.

requirements.title: Scan performance
requirements.text: The tool shall complete a full scan of a 100-file Rust project within 10 seconds on modern hardware.

requirements.title: Memory safety
requirements.text: The tool shall be implemented in safe Rust, with all unsafe blocks explicitly justified.

requirements.title: No external process for core rules
requirements.text: Core FUSA, LINT, and ANA rules shall not spawn external processes; only CYBER and VULN commands may shell out.

requirements.title: Unicode normalisation
requirements.text: The fingerprint function shall apply NFC normalisation to message strings before hashing.

requirements.title: Digit normalisation in fingerprints
requirements.text: The fingerprint function shall replace digit runs with '#' to make fingerprints stable across line number changes.

requirements.title: IEC 62443 gap report command
requirements.text: The tool shall provide an 'iec62443' subcommand that generates a gap report mapping project evidence artefacts to IEC 62443 parts 2-1, 2-4, 3-2, 3-3, 4-1, and 4-2 requirements.

requirements.title: IEC 62443 evidence mapping
requirements.text: The iec62443 gap report shall map at least the following evidence files: tara.json, .fusa-reqs.json, boundary.mermaid, .fusa-evidence.json, vuln.json, sbom.json, check-report.json, cyber-report.json.

requirements.title: IEC 62443 JSON output
requirements.text: The iec62443 subcommand shall support --format json output with kind 'gap-report' conforming to §3.1 common header.

requirements.title: IEC 62443 required vs optional gaps
requirements.text: The iec62443 gap report shall distinguish required (shall) from optional (should/may) requirements and report required gaps separately.

requirements.title: IEC 62443 exit code
requirements.text: The iec62443 subcommand shall exit 1 when required gaps exist and exit 0 when all required evidence is present.

requirements.title: SLSA gap report command
requirements.text: The tool shall provide a 'slsa' subcommand that generates a gap report mapping project evidence artefacts to SLSA supply-chain levels L1 through L3.

requirements.title: SLSA evidence mapping
requirements.text: The slsa gap report shall map at least: provenance.json (L1), .github/workflows/ci.yml (L1/L2), .git (L2), Cargo.lock (L3), sbom.json (L3), vuln.json (L3), audit-pack.zip (L3).

requirements.title: SLSA JSON output
requirements.text: The slsa subcommand shall support --format json output with kind 'gap-report' conforming to §3.1 common header.

requirements.title: SLSA required vs optional gaps
requirements.text: The slsa gap report shall distinguish required from optional SLSA evidence and report required gaps separately.

requirements.title: SLSA exit code
requirements.text: The slsa subcommand shall exit 1 when required gaps exist and exit 0 when all required evidence is present.

requirements.title: Cyclomatic complexity scan
requirements.text: The comp command shall recursively scan all .rs files (excluding target/) and compute McCabe cyclomatic complexity V(G) for each function.

requirements.title: Complexity threshold gate
requirements.text: The comp command shall exit 1 when any function exceeds the configured complexity threshold, and exit 0 otherwise.

requirements.title: Complexity JSON output
requirements.text: The comp command shall write comp-report.json with x-FuSa §3.1 header, threshold, functions[], and summary fields when --format json is specified.

requirements.title: Complexity text output
requirements.text: The comp command shall print a tabular text report showing function name, V(G) value, and VIOLATION/ok status for each function.

requirements.title: DAL threshold presets
requirements.text: The comp command shall support --dal-a (threshold 4), --dal-b (threshold 10), --dal-c (threshold 15), and --dal-d (threshold 20) flags per DO-178C §6.3.4.

requirements.title: Finding span population
requirements.description: Findings SHOULD include endLine and endColumn when span information is derivable from the source text (§4 MAY). Fields MUST be omitted when not available rather than emitting 0.

requirements.title: Project-relative file paths
requirements.text: All location.file paths in JSON output shall be relative to the project root directory, not absolute paths.

requirements.title: Canonical standards identifiers in capabilities
requirements.text: The capabilities.standards array shall use lower-case hyphenated identifiers as specified in §2.4.1 (e.g. 'iso26262', 'iec61508', 'unece-r155').

requirements.title: Traceability matrix markdown output
requirements.text: The trace command shall support --format md to emit the traceability matrix as a Markdown table.

requirements.title: Compliance gap report markdown output
requirements.text: All standards gap report subcommands (iso26262, iec61508, do178c, iso21434, iec62443, slsa, unece) shall support --format md to emit the gap report as a Markdown table.

requirements.title: ISO 21434 gap report command
requirements.text: The tool shall provide an 'iso21434' subcommand that generates a gap report mapping project evidence to ISO/SAE 21434 automotive cybersecurity requirements.

requirements.title: ISO 21434 evidence mapping
requirements.text: The iso21434 gap report shall map evidence files including tara.json, .fusa.json, and cybersecurity plan documentation.

requirements.title: ISO 21434 JSON output
requirements.text: The iso21434 subcommand shall support --format json output with kind 'gap-report' conforming to the x-FuSa gap report schema.

requirements.title: UNECE R.155/R.156 gap report command
requirements.text: The tool shall provide a 'unece' subcommand that generates a gap report mapping project evidence to UNECE R.155 and R.156 cybersecurity management system requirements.

requirements.title: UNECE R.155/R.156 evidence mapping
requirements.text: The unece gap report shall map evidence files including tara.json, cyber-report.json, and vehicle type approval documentation.

requirements.title: UNECE R.155/R.156 JSON output
requirements.text: The unece subcommand shall support --format json output with kind 'gap-report' conforming to the x-FuSa gap report schema.
